title: Oven Roasted British Lamb Shepherds Pie
description: A weeknight British dish featuring sunflower oil and fermented lamb, topped with a cheese-pull crust, served in a salt block vessel.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat sunflower oil over medium-high heat and sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides.
Transfer the lamb to a salt block vessel and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the lamb is roasting, cook the rice according to package instructions and set aside.
In the same skillet used for the lamb, saute the diced onion and minced garlic until the onion is translucent.
Add the frozen peas and carrots to the skillet and cook until thawed.
Stir in the cooked rice, salt, and black pepper, and set aside.
After the lamb has roasted for 20 minutes, remove it from the oven and top with the rice mixture and grated cheddar cheese.
Return the vessel to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the vessel from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
